summary.en:
- Archer is a powerful DPS unit who excels in single to low target fights.
- Acher deals damage to enemies through repeatedly using his Skill. His Skill costs two Skill Points per use and can be used five times a turn. After using his Ultimate, Archer gains two Charges. After an ally uses an attack, Archer consumes a Charge to unleash a Follow-Up ATK and recovers one Skill Point.
- Archer's performance is heavily reliant on Sparkle and/or Rin Tohsaka for Skill Point generation.

details.en:
- E1 refunds 2 Skill Points after his third consecutive Skill.
- S1 [[light-cone:the-finale-of-a-lie]] grants the wearer an ATK% buff and applies a Vulnerability debuff to enemies. Archer can consistently satisfy the Light Cone's Follow-Up ATK requirement through his Talent and his Joint Follow-Up ATK with Rin Tohsaka.
- E2 reduces the Quantum RES of enemies hit by his Ultimate for 2 turns.
